en.g: Talk about things that are possible but not certain.
p: Might and may + verb mean perhaps: I might go to the party. It may snow tonight.
No -s and no to: She might come, not She mights come or She might to come.
Negative: I might not have time. It may not be open on Sunday.
en.q: What might you do this weekend? Tell me two possible plans.
en.c: Write five sentences about next month with might, may and might not.

Verneinung: I might not have time. It may not be open on Sunday.
de.q: Was machst du vielleicht am Wochenende? Nenn mir zwei mögliche Pläne.

en.g: Ask for permission politely and answer kindly.
p: Asking: Can I...? (casual) Could I...? (polite) May I...? (formal) Is it OK if I...?
Do you mind if I open the window? Answer No, not at all / No, go ahead = yes, you can.
Saying yes or no: Sure, go ahead. Of course. I'm sorry, but... / I'd rather you didn't.
en.q: Imagine you're staying at a friend's house. What would you ask permission to do?
en.c: Write four permission questions with can, could, is it OK if and do you mind if, plus answers.

Do you mind if I open the window? Antwort No, not at all / No, go ahead = ja, gern.
Ja oder nein: Sure, go ahead. Of course. I'm sorry, but... / I'd rather you didn't.

en.t: Indirect questions: Could you tell me...?
en.g: Make questions softer and more polite with indirect forms.
p: Start with Do you know...? / Could you tell me...? / I wonder... + the question.
Word order changes: Where is the station? becomes Do you know where the station is?
No do/does/did: What time does it open? becomes Could you tell me what time it opens?
en.q: How would you politely ask a stranger for directions to your favourite place?
en.c: Turn five direct questions into indirect ones with Do you know or Could you tell me.

de.t: Indirekte Fragen: Could you tell me...?
de.g: Du machst Fragen mit indirekten Formen weicher und höflicher.
p: Beginn mit Do you know...? / Could you tell me...? / I wonder... + Frage.
Die Wortstellung ändert sich: Where is the station? wird Do you know where the station is?
Ohne do/does/did: What time does it open? wird Could you tell me what time it opens?
de.q: Wie würdest du eine fremde Person höflich nach dem Weg zu deinem Lieblingsort fragen?
de.c: Mach aus fünf direkten Fragen indirekte mit Do you know oder Could you tell me.

Sin do/does/did: What time does it open? pasa a Could you tell me what time it opens?
es.q: ¿Cómo preguntarías con educación a un desconocido cómo llegar a tu lugar favorito?
es.c: Convierte cinco preguntas directas en indirectas con Do you know o Could you tell me.

fr.t: Questions indirectes : Could you tell me...?

fr.q: Comment demanderais-tu poliment à un inconnu le chemin vers ton endroit préféré ?

en.g: Use question tags to check information and keep a chat going.
p: Positive sentence, negative tag: It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Negative sentence, positive tag: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Use the same auxiliary: You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
en.q: It's nice to practise together, isn't it? Can you reply and add a question tag of your own?
en.c: Write six sentences about the weather, food and friends, each ending with a question tag.

de.g: Du nutzt Frageanhängsel, um nachzufragen und das Gespräch am Laufen zu halten.
p: Positiver Satz, negativer Tag: It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Negativer Satz, positiver Tag: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Gleiches Hilfsverb: You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
de.q: Es macht Spaß, zusammen zu üben, isn't it? Antworte und häng selbst ein Question Tag an.
de.c: Schreib sechs Sätze über Wetter, Essen und Freunde, jeder mit einem Question Tag am Ende.

es.g: Usa las coletillas para confirmar información y mantener la charla.
p: Frase afirmativa, coletilla negativa: It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Frase negativa, coletilla afirmativa: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Usa el mismo auxiliar: You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
es.q: Es agradable practicar juntos, isn't it? ¿Puedes responder y añadir tu propia coletilla?
es.c: Escribe seis frases sobre el tiempo, la comida y los amigos, cada una con una coletilla.

fr.g: Utiliser les question tags pour vérifier une info et faire vivre la conversation.
p: Phrase affirmative, tag négatif : It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Phrase négative, tag affirmatif : You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Même auxiliaire : You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
fr.q: C'est sympa de pratiquer ensemble, isn't it? Peux-tu répondre en ajoutant ton propre tag ?
fr.c: Écris six phrases sur la météo, la nourriture et les amis, chacune avec un question tag.

it.g: Usa le question tags per verificare informazioni e tenere viva la conversazione.
p: Frase affermativa, tag negativa: It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Frase negativa, tag affermativa: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Stesso ausiliare: You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
it.q: È bello esercitarsi insieme, isn't it? Puoi rispondere aggiungendo una tua question tag?
it.c: Scrivi sei frasi su tempo, cibo e amici, ognuna con una question tag finale.

pt.g: Usa as question tags para confirmar informação e manter a conversa.
p: Frase afirmativa, tag negativa: It's cold, isn't it? You're from Spain, aren't you?
Frase negativa, tag afirmativa: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?
Usa o mesmo auxiliar: You live here, don't you? They went home, didn't they?
pt.q: É bom praticar juntos, isn't it? Consegues responder e juntar uma question tag tua?
pt.c: Escreve seis frases sobre o tempo, a comida e os amigos, cada uma com uma question tag.

pt_BR.g: Use as question tags para confirmar informações e manter a conversa.

Frase negativa, tag afirmativa: You don't eat meat, do you? She can't swim, can she?

pt_BR.q: É legal praticar juntos, isn't it? Você consegue responder e acrescentar sua própria question tag?
pt_BR.c: Escreva seis frases sobre o tempo, a comida e os amigos, cada uma com uma question tag.

vocab.ex: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
You're coming tonight, aren't you?
You work near here, don't you?
You don't like spicy food, do you?

target.gram: Positive sentence + negative tag, negative sentence + positive tag, same auxiliary and a pronoun: He's late, isn't he?

en.t: Agreeing: so do I, neither do I
en.g: Show you feel the same as someone in a natural way.
p: Positive: I love pizza. So do I. / Me too. I'm tired. So am I.
Negative: I don't like rain. Neither do I. / Me neither. I can't swim. Neither can I.
Match the auxiliary: I went home early. So did I. I've been there. So have I.
en.q: I love learning languages. Do you? Answer me with so do I or something different!
en.c: Write six short exchanges where you agree, using so do I, so am I, neither do I and neither can I.

de.t: Zustimmen: so do I, neither do I
de.g: Du zeigst ganz natürlich, dass es dir genauso geht.
p: Positiv: I love pizza. So do I. / Me too. I'm tired. So am I.
Negativ: I don't like rain. Neither do I. / Me neither. I can't swim. Neither can I.
Hilfsverb anpassen: I went home early. So did I. I've been there. So have I.
de.q: I love learning languages. Und du? Antworte mit so do I oder etwas anderem!
de.c: Schreib sechs kurze Dialoge, in denen du zustimmst: so do I, so am I, neither do I, neither can I.

en.t: Expressing opinions: I think, in my opinion
en.g: Share your opinions clearly and give a reason.
p: Openers: I think..., I believe..., In my opinion..., For me..., Personally, I...
Give a reason: I think cycling is great because it's healthy and cheap.
Negative opinions: I don't think it's a good idea (more natural than I think it isn't).
en.q: In your opinion, what's the best way to learn a new language, and why?
en.c: Write your opinion on three topics (food, cities, technology) with a different opener and a reason.

de.t: Meinungen äußern: I think, in my opinion
de.g: Du sagst klar deine Meinung und gibst einen Grund an.
p: Einstiege: I think..., I believe..., In my opinion..., For me..., Personally, I...
Mit Grund: I think cycling is great because it's healthy and cheap.
Negative Meinung: I don't think it's a good idea (natürlicher als I think it isn't).
de.q: Was ist deiner Meinung nach der beste Weg, eine neue Sprache zu lernen, und warum?
de.c: Sag deine Meinung zu drei Themen (Essen, Städte, Technik) mit je anderem Einstieg und Grund.

es.t: Dar opiniones: I think, in my opinion
es.g: Comparte tus opiniones con claridad y da un motivo.
p: Para empezar: I think..., I believe..., In my opinion..., For me..., Personally, I...
Con motivo: I think cycling is great because it's healthy and cheap.
Opinión negativa: I don't think it's a good idea (más natural que I think it isn't).
es.q: En tu opinión, ¿cuál es la mejor forma de aprender un idioma nuevo, y por qué?
es.c: Da tu opinión sobre tres temas (comida, ciudades, tecnología) con distinto inicio y un motivo.

fr.t: Donner son avis : I think, in my opinion

Avis négatif : I don't think it's a good idea (plus naturel que I think it isn't).
fr.q: À ton avis, quelle est la meilleure façon d'apprendre une nouvelle langue, et pourquoi ?
fr.c: Donne ton avis sur trois sujets (cuisine, villes, technologie) avec une formule différente et une raison.

Opinione negativa: I don't think it's a good idea (più naturale di I think it isn't).
it.q: Secondo te, qual è il modo migliore per imparare una nuova lingua, e perché?
it.c: Dai la tua opinione su tre temi (cibo, città, tecnologia) con un inizio diverso e un motivo.

target.gram: Give opinions with I think/believe + clause, In my opinion + clause. For negatives, prefer I don't think + positive clause.

en.g: Agree warmly and disagree kindly in a conversation.
p: Agreeing: I totally agree. You're absolutely right. That's a good point.
Disagreeing kindly: I see your point, but... I'm not so sure. I see it a bit differently.
Soften it: Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
en.q: I think breakfast is the most important meal of the day. Do you agree or disagree?
en.c: Write three statements and reply to each: once agreeing, once half-agreeing, once disagreeing kindly.

de.g: Du stimmst herzlich zu und widersprichst freundlich.
p: Zustimmen: I totally agree. You're absolutely right. That's a good point.
Freundlich widersprechen: I see your point, but... I'm not so sure. I see it a bit differently.
Abschwächen: Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
de.q: Ich finde, das Frühstück ist die wichtigste Mahlzeit des Tages. Stimmst du zu oder nicht?
de.c: Schreib drei Aussagen und antworte: einmal zustimmend, einmal halb, einmal freundlich widersprechend.

es.t: Estar de acuerdo y discrepar con educación

Discrepar con amabilidad: I see your point, but... I'm not so sure. I see it a bit differently.
Suavizar: Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
es.q: Creo que el desayuno es la comida más importante del día. ¿Estás de acuerdo o no?
es.c: Escribe tres afirmaciones y responde: una de acuerdo, otra a medias y otra discrepando con amabilidad.

fr.g: Approuver chaleureusement et exprimer son désaccord avec gentillesse.
p: Accord : I totally agree. You're absolutely right. That's a good point.
Désaccord poli : I see your point, but... I'm not so sure. I see it a bit differently.
Adoucir : Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
fr.q: Je pense que le petit-déjeuner est le repas le plus important. Tu es d'accord ou pas ?
fr.c: Écris trois affirmations et réponds : une fois d'accord, une fois à moitié, une fois en désaccord poli.

it.t: Essere d'accordo o no, con gentilezza

Ammorbidire: Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
it.q: Penso che la colazione sia il pasto più importante della giornata. Sei d'accordo o no?
it.c: Scrivi tre affermazioni e rispondi: una volta d'accordo, una a metà, una in disaccordo gentile.

pt.g: Concorda com simpatia e discorda com delicadeza.

Suavizar: Maybe, but don't you think...? That's true, although...
pt.q: Acho que o pequeno-almoço é a refeição mais importante do dia. Concordas ou não?
pt.c: Escreve três afirmações e responde: uma vez a concordar, outra em parte e outra a discordar com delicadeza.

pt_BR.g: Concorde com simpatia e discorde com delicadeza.

vocab.ex: I totally agree. It's a great idea.
That's a good point. I hadn't thought of that.
I see your point, but it's quite expensive.
I'm not so sure. It might be too far.
That's true, although it takes a long time.
I see it a bit differently, actually.

target.gram: Soften disagreement with I see your point, but... or I'm not so sure. Avoid a bare No, you're wrong: it sounds rude in English.
